meta.title: Riad Berber Towers · Hand-built guesthouse in Imlil, High Atlas
meta.description: Seven hand-built rooms in the heart of Imlil, steps from the Toubkal trail. Tadelakt, Fes zellij and carved Atlas cedar. Breakfast included.

brand.descriptor: Made by hand in the heart of Imlil.

home.title: Seven rooms. One valley. Made by hand.
home.comingSoon: Our new website is being built.

footer.address: Imlil Centre, Asni · Al Haouz, Morocco
footer.fromMarrakech: 64 km from Marrakech, about 90 minutes by road

wip.title: This page is being built
wip.body: We are crafting this page by hand, like the house itself. In the meantime, our team answers every question on WhatsApp and by email.

rooms.title: Rooms & suites
rooms.intro: Seven rooms on three floors, each built by hand with tadelakt, zellij and carved cedar. Every night includes breakfast on the roof terrace, heated floors and Wi-Fi.
rooms.onlineSoon: Online booking opens soon. Until then we confirm every request within a few hours.
